info.title: DotnetSdkManager
info.description: A user-scoped, secure .NET SDK version manager.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Secure, user-scoped .NET SDK installation and selection.

commands.name: activate
commands.description: Select an installed managed SDK for the PATH shim.

commands.name: available
commands.description: List SDKs available for a channel and RID.

commands.name: clean
commands.description: Clear metadata and download caches.

options.name: --index
options.description: Release-index URI. Defaults to the official .NET index.

options.name: --allow-host
options.description: Admit an additional exact host; may be repeated.

options.name: --allow-http
options.description: Permit HTTP as well as HTTPS. Intended for controlled feeds.

options.name: --offline
options.description: Use cached metadata and do not make metadata requests.

options.name: --home
options.description: Override the manager home for this invocation.

options.name: --channel
options.description: LTS, STS, CURRENT, or an exact major.minor channel.

options.name: --rid
options.description: Target installation RID. Defaults to the current process RID.

options.name: --artifact-rid
options.description: Require an exact release artifact RID.

options.name: --include-preview
options.description: Admit prerelease SDKs and preview/go-live channels.

options.name: --allow-eol
options.description: Admit end-of-life channels.

options.name: --archive
options.description: Install a local SDK archive; exact version and SHA-512 required.

options.name: --url
options.description: Install a direct SDK archive; exact version and SHA-512 required.

options.name: --sha512
options.description: Trusted SHA-512 in hexadecimal or Base64.

options.name: --activate
options.description: Activate after installation.

options.name: --force
options.description: Atomically replace a different managed artifact.

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit JSON where supported.

options.name: --managed-only
options.description: Omit read-only system inventory from list.

options.name: --roll-forward
options.description: Set global.json rollForward for SDK 3.0 or newer.

options.name: --allow-prerelease
options.description: Set global.json allowPrerelease to true.

options.name: --no-allow-prerelease
options.description: Set global.json allowPrerelease to false.

options.name: --allow-uninstalled
options.description: Permit pinning an SDK absent from managed inventory.

options.name: --shell
options.description: bash, zsh, sh, fish, powershell, or cmd.

options.name: --no-activate
options.description: Do not activate after upgrade.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help.

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show the manager version.
Security defaults:
* Package-manager SDKs are never changed.
* HTTPS and an admitted host are required.
* Every archive requires SHA-512 verification.
* EOL and preview selection are explicit opt-ins.
* Archive traversal and link entries are rejected.
